integrity: The proof uses an explicit equivariant deformation retraction, integral exterior-power homology, and equivariant Alexander duality; finite computational checks are corroborative rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to unions of complete graph components, each size at least two, with 3<=k<=c; no claim for ordinary cut complexes or arbitrary chordal graphs. This is a self-review only; independent audit not performed. Novelty relative to identified indexed literature cannot establish global uniqueness.
title: Integral automorphism representations of total cut complexes of clique unions
